    Quotients of ray categories by proper zero ideals #

    The quotient of a (possibly infinite) ray category by a proper zero Hom ideal is again a ray category (isRayCategory_quotient). This is the stage construction of Fischbacher's Satz 5.1: quotients of the universal cover by ideals generated by arrows.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.quot_map_rpow {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] (I : ZeroHomIdeal C) {X : C} (e : X ⟶ X) (n : ℕ) :
    (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel).map (rpow e n) = rpow ((CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel).map e) n
